ablation.name: brk_y_ml_dwt_a05
ablation.notes: Multi-level DWT: LL1 -> DWT2 -> {LL2, LH2, HL2, HH2}. LL2 locked (content core), LH2/HL2/HH2 stylized at alpha2=0.5. Math: target = IDWT1(IDWT2(LL2_c, LH2_blend, HL2_blend, HH2_blend), LH1_s, HL1_s, HH1_s). Theory: single-level alpha=0.3 stylizes entire LL1 (incl mid-freq) coarsely; multi-level separates mid-freq from lowest-freq, allowing aggressive mid-freq migration (alpha2=0.5) without breaking content core (LL2 locked). DINOv2 CLS token is sensitive to mid-freq color statistics. Target: DINO-S>0.485.
